description: Vulnerabilidad por Ola de calor is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad de Madrid. El Catálogo de Riesgos Potenciales de Protección Civil para la Comunidad de Madrid realiza un análisis de la peligrosidad y vulnerabilidad conjugándolos para obtener una evaluación de los riesgos de la Comunidad de Madrid. Coverage: Comunidad de Madrid. The portal shows the English title as "Vulnerability by Heatwave" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad de Madrid. Its keywords include Conjuntos de datos de alto valor, High-value dataset, Ola de calor, Earth observation and environment, Comunidad de Madrid, Zonas de riesgos naturales. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS_XML, PLAIN, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
